page_title: MON 2-2 VEN | Monza v Venezia 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Venezia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+4' The whistle blows and Milan Djuric (Monza) is booked for an infringement.
90+2' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gianluca Busio departs the field of play to be replaced by Antonio Raimondo (Venezia).
84' The referee signals a substitution. Mattia Valoti is brought on as a substitute for Dany Mota (Monza).
80' Warren Bondo (Monza) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daniel Maldini (Monza) for Matteo Pessina.
76' That's a clear yellow card. Francesco Zampano (Venezia) goes into the book.
76' Warren Bondo (Monza) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
75' PENALTY APPEAL after Warren Bondo (Monza) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
72' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. John Yeboah replaces Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Christian Gytkjaer is replacing Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia).
72' The foul by Gianluca Busio (Venezia) was seen by Antonio Rapuano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
70' A corner kick by Monza is thwarted by the well prepared Filip Stankovic (Venezia).

69' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alessandro Bianco (Monza) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monza.
67' Dany Mota (Monza) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
64' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) goes off the pitch and Hans Nicolussi Caviglia comes on.
64' Here comes a substitution. Ridgeciano Haps is given a rest as he is replaced by Giorgio Altare (Venezia).
62' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

61' The ball is cleared after Armando Izzo (Monza) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' The substitution is prepared. Danilo D'Ambrosio joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedro Pereira (Monza).
60' The substitution has been made. Alessandro Bianco has replaced Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
57' Armando Izzo (Monza) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
56' Close! Gianluca Busio (Venezia) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
51' Yellow card. Gianluca Busio (Venezia) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
50' Dany Mota (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
50' Dany Mota (Monza) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' 2 - 2 Goal! Milan Djuric (Monza) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Georgios Kyriakopoulos, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
42' Andrea Carboni (Monza) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
42' It seemed like Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
42' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Francesco Zampano (Venezia). Monza have a free kick.
41' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

39' 1 - 2 Perfectly taken free kick! Magnus Kofod Andersen sends the ball in, Michael Svoboda (Venezia) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header low inside the left post. It's 1:2.
39' Venezia are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
38' Matteo Pessina (Monza) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
34' Matteo Pessina (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but Filip Stankovic punches the ball away.
30' Wasted opportunity! Warren Bondo (Monza) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
30' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jay Idzes (Venezia).
28' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
27' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Venezia will have an opportunity.
26' Dany Mota (Monza) commits a foul and Antonio Rapuano immediately signals a free kick.

23' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Pedro Pereira. The score is now 1:1.
23' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
20' Monza fail to score from a corner as Filip Stankovic (Venezia) leaps to collect the ball.
20' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Gaetano Oristanio pulls the ball back for Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike inside the left post. 0:1.
13' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
12' Milan Djuric (Monza) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar.
12' It seemed like Gianluca Caprari (Monza) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
9' This shall not pass! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
6' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
4' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
4' Warren Bondo (Monza) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monza will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
